src: single red start pixel on the left edge
path: start horizontally; each ray paints until the first original colored marker in each direction, then emits the perpendicular row or column from the cell just before that marker
trajectory: paint traversed background pixels red while preserving all original markers
multi_step: process emitted rows/columns depth-first; each marker opens at most once, later hits only stop, and a lower-edge orange marker hit from above is terminal
